svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two cross rails 800 mm long, 1,060 mm apart (centres).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two long rails 1,000 mm between them, at 120 mm in front of and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 190 mm behind the pinch line (centres), flush on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld on a flat floor or table; diagonals within 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: four 13 mm holes in each long rail for the side frame feet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (two per foot, 50 mm apart), 467.5 mm each side of the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the side frame legs stand on foot plates bolted to the long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rails with 2 x M12 each. The cross rails stick out 400 mm each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: way so the stand cannot tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rocks on no corner on a flat floor; shim if needed.
